_note: Constants of the annular throat kernel's application stages (a1_annular_kernel.py: chutkey, domain), kept as DATA with class and provenance per the validation numeric ratchet (R28); the verify stage's rungs are the carrier's birth literals.

chutkey_primary_arc_radius_m.note: Chutkey et al. 2014 p. 479: the primary nozzle's walls end in circular arcs of radius 0.867 mm at the throat (X1 in [-0.617, 0] mm), both walls (symmetric duct)

z_span.note: half-range of the stretched axial variable scanned for the sonic line: the series' own range (|z| ~ 1 = one throat-scale in x)

z_scan_points.note: resolution of the sonic-line scan in z (5e-4 x 1.5 of z, i.e. 1e-3 of the sonic line's span)

n_y_profile.note: points across the throat for the profiles and the convergence norms (the Chebyshev grid has 48; 41 samples resolve it)

n_y_mass.note: trapezoid points across the throat for the mass integral (1e-6 class on smooth profiles)

discharge_band.note: the transonic discharge coefficient of a smooth throat lies below the 1-D choked value and above 0.95 (Back et al. 1965, Kliegel-Levine 1969: 0.98-0.997 for R_c 0.6-2)

rc_ladder.note: the convergence map's rungs: Chutkey's 0.33, Dutton's tested 0.5 and 0.625 (Fig. 2-3: R_co 0.625) and 1.0 (Fig. 6-7), and two smooth throats

eta_ladder.note: the re-summation parameter around Dutton's recommended eta = 2

rc_converged_from.note: the domain gate: the series must converge (third term below the second, eta-spread within twice the third term) from this R_c up; measured 2026-09-21: ratio 0.63/0.71 at 1.0, marginal 0.8-0.9 at 0.5-0.625

axis_y_i.note: the axis limit posed as a centerbody of radius 1e-3 separations (D^2 = 2/(1 + y_i/y_o) converges to Sauer's 2 at O(y_i))
